description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithLocationId' which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides functionality to format a location name based on a location ID, using the 'LocationService' to retrieve location data within the 'OrangeHRM' Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: FormatWithLocationId
classes.description: A class that retrieves and formats the name of a location given its ID, using a LocationService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the location name associated with a given location ID.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.
